d:
Welcome to the most beautiful hand-painted village in Ghatshila! We take you on an exclusive travel vlog tour to show the stunning traditional art and cultural life of this incredible location. This village is a hidden gem with vibrant art covering every home, and it’s a must-see for any travel and art lover!
Chapter:
This unique destination in Ghatshila showcases incredible regional art. Learn about the techniques used to paint these beautiful homes and experience the rich cultural heritage firsthand. It's a truly inspiring place to visit and photograph!
